Trb Advisors LP Increased Its Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Position by $8.34 Million; Suncoast Equity Management Has Lowered Accenture LTD (ACN) Stake by $666,774; Share Value Declined 
April 23, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson 
Trb Advisors Lp increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 300% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Trb Advisors Lp bought 60,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 80,000 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.18M, up from 20,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Trb Advisors Lp who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $339.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.70% or $0.89 during the last trading session, reaching $126.66. About 7.74M shares traded. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has risen 1.12% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.43% the S&P500. 
Suncoast Equity Management decreased its stake in Accenture Ltd (ACN) by 2.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suncoast Equity Management sold 4,358 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 194,470 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $29.77M, down from 198,828 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suncoast Equity Management who had been investing in Accenture Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $98.01B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.41% or $2.18 during the last trading session, reaching $152.41. About 2.30M shares traded. Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) has risen 24.68% since April 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.13% the S&P500. 
Suncoast Equity Management, which manages about $229.33 million and $362.34 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Vmware Inc Cl A (NYSE:VMW) by 45,259 shares to 113,748 shares, valued at $14.26M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.

Analysts await Accenture plc (NYSE:ACN) to report earnings on June, 28. They expect $1.71 EPS, up 12.50% or $0.19 from last year’s $1.52 per share. ACN’s profit will be $1.10 billion for 22.28 P/E if the $1.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.58 actual EPS reported by Accenture plc for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 8.23% EPS growth.
